items.change: The party arrived at Brandonsford following a treasure map whose marked locations they don't recognize.
items.impact_basis: beat_1 establishes the treasure map as the reason the party came to Brandonsford, setting their main goal.
items.lasting_basis: beat_1 shows the treasure remains unfound, so the map will drive later Sessions.

items.change: Eric the Reeve offered 1000 gold to whoever kills the black dragon troubling Brandonsford and drags its body into town.
items.impact_basis: beat_16 gives a major bounty, with beat_17 and beat_27 supplying leads on the black dragon and Gill's sons hunting it.
items.lasting_basis: beats 16, 17 and 27 set up an open dragon hunt likely to shape later Sessions.

items.change: Reginald the Frog warned that a trickster Clurichen comes from the riverbanks into town every night.
items.impact_basis: beat_7 reveals a new nightly danger in town.
items.lasting_basis: beat_7's Clurichen is unexplored and may tie to the nightly thefts, so it is likely to return.

items.change: Lady Hilda offered to join the dragon hunt for pay, and Sir Phidipaldi said they would return to hire her.
items.impact_basis: beat_10 presents a seasoned potential ally for the dragon hunt.
items.lasting_basis: beat_10 leaves an open hiring arrangement likely to come up when the hunt begins.

items.change: The party learned that shipments into Brandonsford have stopped, leaving Bentley's restock a week overdue and the smith with little to sell.
items.impact_basis: beat_13 and beat_29 reveal an unexplained supply disruption in town.
items.lasting_basis: The unexplained cause in beats 13 and 29 is an open mystery that may come up again.

items.change: Drop Dead Ned offered himself and his killer wasp for hire at 100 gold a week, and Dr. Uriah said he'd think about it.
items.impact_basis: beat_21 gives a dangerous potential hireling offer.
items.lasting_basis: beat_21 leaves the offer open, so it may come up again.

items.change: Farmer Gill offered Dunk the shabby mule Shamus for 100 gold, and Dunk is thinking it over.
items.impact_basis: beat_25 is an offer to sell an ordinary mule.
items.lasting_basis: beat_28 leaves a minor purchase pending.

items.change: Sir Phidipaldi agreed to Quinn's 100-gold plan to stage a fake ale delivery and catch whoever empties his bar at night.
items.impact_basis: beat_36 is an agreement made, and beat_34 reveals the nightly emptying of Quinn's bar.
items.lasting_basis: beat_36's plan has not happened yet and will likely play out next Session.

items.change: Sir Phidipaldi slapped Eric the Reeve with his glove and challenged him to a duel at dawn, which Eric did not accept.
items.impact_basis: beat_19 strains relations with the Reeve who offered the bounty.
items.lasting_basis: beat_19's refused challenge may color later dealings with Eric, but no duel is set.

items.change: Bentley sent Sir Phidipaldi to spend the night at the Golden Egg after his argument with the Reeve grew heated.
items.impact_basis: beat_23 moves Sir Phidipaldi to the other inn, leading to the Quinn meeting.

items.change: A night watchman let the party into Brandonsford after Sir Phidipaldi invoked Zeus's law of hospitality.
items.impact_basis: beat_2 is routine entry into town.
items.lasting_basis: beat_2 and beats 3-4 give only background on the town.
items.encounter_basis: The gate exchange is routine arrival logistics; the arrival itself is covered by thread_1.

items.change: Dr. Uriah spoke with Reginald the Frog, who warned of a nightly Clurichen.
items.impact_basis: beat_7 is the warning about the Clurichen.
items.lasting_basis: beat_7's warning is likely to matter again.
items.encounter_basis: The central interaction is the Clurichen warning, which thread_3 already tells.

items.change: At the Clumsy Fox, the party met Lady Hilda, Bentley, Eric the Reeve and Drop Dead Ned, took up the dragon bounty, and Sir Phidipaldi's quarrel with the Reeve got him sent away.
items.impact_basis: beat_16, beat_10 and beat_21 deliver the bounty and the hire offers, and beats 18-19 sour relations with the Reeve.
items.lasting_basis: beat_16 and the open offers in beats 10 and 21 will shape later Sessions.
items.encounter_basis: The key events are the bounty, the hire offers and the duel challenge, each told by its own candidate; the tavern evening adds little beyond them.

items.change: Dunk spent the evening drinking with Farmer Gill, who offered his mule, told the tale of Sir Brandon's dragon slaying, and shared town gossip.
items.impact_basis: beats 26, 27 and 29 add dragon history, Gill's sons on the hunt and the smith's mithril shirt.
items.lasting_basis: Gill's hospitality in beat_28 and the leads in beats 26 and 27 are likely to come up again.
items.encounter_basis: Gill's hospitality toward Dunk and his lore about Sir Brandon's fairy-given magic sword would otherwise disappear, beyond the mule offer and the dragon leads.

items.change: Quinn hired Sir Phidipaldi to stage a fake ale shipment to catch the nightly thief of his bar.
items.impact_basis: beat_36 is the agreement, with beat_34 as its mystery.
items.lasting_basis: beat_36's pending plan will likely play out later.
items.encounter_basis: The central interaction is Quinn's scheme, which thread_8 already tells.
